senses.gloss: वीज- + अङ्कुर वीज- + अङ्कुर, m. a seedling, Pañc. i. d. 254.
वीज- + अश्व वीज- + अश्व, m. a stallion, Rājat. 5, 280.
विजय- + ईश विजय- + ईश, m. a name of Śiva, Rājat. 5, 46.
विजय-रथ-कुटुम्ब विजय-रथ-कुटुम्ब, adj. taking care of Vijaya's chariot as a father would a household, Bhāg. P. 1, 9, 39.
वि- + जन वि- + जन, adj. lonely, private; loc. ˚ने, privately, Pañc. 58, 8.

I. n. विज् + अन.
 1. Fanning, being fanned, Rājat. 5, 386.
 2. A fan.
 II. n. Thing.
 III. m.
 1. A sort of pheasant.
 2. The ruddy goose.

वि- + जन्मन् वि- + जन्मन्,
 I. adj. born by a paramour (ŚKD.).
 II. m. the son of an outcaste Vaiśya, Man. 10, 23.
वि- + जातीय वि- + जातीय, adj. 1. of mixed origin. 2. of a different cast. 3. of a different kind, dissimilar.
वि- + जिह्म वि- + जिह्म, adj. 1. crooked. 2. dishonest.
वीज- + पुष्प वीज- + पुष्प, n. 1. common citron. 2. a thorny plant, Vangueria spinosa.

वीज- + पूर्ण वीज- + पूर्ण, m. common citron, or a large kind of lime.
 II. पूर्त,
 1. Filled, Bhāg. P. 3, 24, 32; full.
 2. Complete; with धर्म-, An act of pious liberality (see n.).
 3. Covered. n. An act of pious liberality, as digging a well, etc., Man. 4, 226.
वीज-काण्ड- + रुह वीज-काण्ड- + रुह, adj. springing from a seed, or from a slip, Man. 1, 48.

1. विज् विज्, ii. 7, विनज्, विञ्ज्, Par.
 1. To tremble.
 2. To fear.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. विग्न, Trembling, Ragh. 14, 88.
 --Caus. वेजय, To terrify, Ragh. 8, 39.
 --With the prep. आ आ, आविग्न, Terrified, Arj. 6, 9.
 --With उद् उद्, i. 6, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 1, 5549; and i. 1, Ātm., MBh. 3, 2322).
 1. To tremble, to be agitated, MBh. 3, 2322.
 2. To suffer uneasiness, Man. 2, 161.
 3. To fear (with the abl. and gen.), Man. 2, 162; 7, 103; to abhor, Pañc. iii. d. 191; to be reckless of (with abl.), Mālat. 51, 1.
 4. To terrify, MBh. 2, 178. उद्विग्न,
 1. Terrified, Rām. 1, 9, 12.
 2. Afflicted, sorrowful, Hit. 4, 2, M.M.; Chr. 11, 14.
 3. Anxious.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut., pass. उद्वेजनीय.
 1. To be feared, Pañc. iii. d. 142; fearful, horrible.
 --Caus. To terrify, MBh. 1, 8427. उद्वेजित,
 1. Terrified, Pañc. 209, 23.
 2. Grieved, pained, Pañc. 222, 7.
 3. Caused to loathe, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 16; 185, 5.
 --With निरुद् निस्-उद्, निरुद्विग्न, Fearless (rather उद्विग्न with निस्), Rām. 6, 16, 81.
 --With पर्युद् परि-उद्, To suffer, [] Rām. 2, 66, 9.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, समुद्विग्न, Terrified, anxious, Lass. 50, 16.
 --With वि वि, विविग्न, Agitated, stirred, Rājat. 5, 339.
 --With सम् सम्, संविग्न, Very frightened, MBh. 3, 2561.
 --Cf. probably ἀΐσσω; A.S. wicelian, vacillare, wince, A winch.
† 2. विज् विज्, ii. 3, वेविज्, Par. Ātm. To be separate, to separate; cf. विच्, at the end.
3. विज् विज् (m.), A die, for playing with, Chr. 295, 10 = Rigv. i. 92, 10.

वीज् वीज्, † i. 1, Ātm. To go.
 --i. 10 (properly a denomin. derived from व्यज), Par. To fan, Mālat. 63, 9; Chr. 25, 56.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, i. 10, To fan, MBh. 3, 1764.
 --With उद् उद्, i. 10, To fan, MBh. 3, 1757.
 --With उप उप, i. 10, To fan, Śāk. 33, 6.
विजनन वि-जन् + अन, n. Birth, delivery.

विजय विजय, i. e. वि-जि + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Victory, Pañc. iii. d. 11.
 2. Overpowering, Pañc. 168, 25.
 3. A name of Arjuna.
 4. Name of an auspicious hour, Rām. 1, 73, 1.
 II. f. या
 1. Durgā.
 2. The name of several plants.
 --Comp.
विजयन्त वि-जयन्त् + अ (vb. जि), m. Indra.

विजयिन् विजयिन्, i. e. विजय + इन्,
 I. adj. Victorious, Hit. iii. d. 84.
 II. m. Conqueror, Pañc. iii. d. 270.
 --Comp.
विजिगीष विजिगीष, i. e. वि-जिगीष, desider. of जि, + अ, adj. Desirous of conquering, emulative.
विजिगीषा विजिगीषा, i. e. वि-जिगीष + आ (see the last), f. Wish to surpass, emulation.
विजिगीषिन् विजिगीषिन्, i. e. वि-जिगीष + इन् (see the last), adj. Desirous of victory, Johns. Sel. 56, 156.

विजिगीषु विजिगीषु, i. e. वि-जिगीष + उ (see the last),
 I. adj.
 1. One who wishes [] to conquer, Man. 7, 155; Pañc. iii. d. 36.
 2. Desirous to surpass.
 II. m.
 1. A warrior.
 2. An invader.
 3. A disputant.
विजिल विजिल, and विजिविल विजिविल, adj. Mixed with rice-water or gruel (sauces, etc.).

विजृम्भण विजृम्भण, i. e. वि-जृम्भ् + अन, n.
 1. Yawning.
 2. Expanding, extending, Mālat. 144, 20.
 3. Sport.

विजेतृ विजेतृ, i. e. वि-जि + तृ, m., f. तॄ, n.
 1. A conqueror, Kir. 5, 34; Utt. Rāmac. 62, 14.
 2. Victorious.

विज्जल विज्जल,
 I. adj. = विजिल.
 II. n. An arrow.

विज्ञ वि-ज्ञ, adj.
 1. Knowing, Lass. 2. ed. 90, 44.
 2. Wise, Cāṇ. 20 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 408; Hit. ii. d. 151 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2042).
 3. Skilful.

विज्ञान विज्ञान, i. e. वि-ज्ञा + अन, n.
 1. Knowledge, Hit. ii. d. 142.
 2. Learning.
 3. Wisdom, Hit. i. d. 167, M.M.
 4. Art, Śāk. d. 2.
 5. Music.
 6. Intelligence, Chr. 6, 9 (at the end of a comp. adj.).
 7. Distinction, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 5.
 8. Business, employment.
 --Comp.

विज्ञापक विज्ञापक, i. e. वि-ज्ञा, Caus., + अक,
 I. adj. Who or what makes known.
 II. m.
 1. An informant.
 2. An instructor.

विज्ञापन विज्ञापन, i. e. वि-ज्ञा, Caus., + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Teaching.
 2. Informing, representing.
 II. f. ना, Information, Ragh. 17, 40.

वीज वीज, also बीज बीज, i. e. probably [] वि-ज (vb. जन्), n.
 1. Seed, germ, Śāk. 91, 14; Pañc. 51, 11; 200, 12.
 2. Semen virile.
 3. Receptacle, place of deposit.
 4. Marrow.
 5. Origin.
 6. Divine truth as the cause of being.
 7. The origin of the business of a drama.
 8. The mystical syllable which forms the essential part of the मन्त्र of any deity.
 9. Algebra.
 --Comp.

वीजक वीज + क,
 1. m. The common citron, Rām. 2, 69, 8, ed. Seramp.
 2. A substitute for वीज, as latter part of a comp. adj., e. g. अ-, adj. Not sown, Man. 10, 71.
वीजवत् वीज + वत्, adv. Like seed.
वीजवन्त् वीज + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Who or what has seed.

वीजिन् वीजिन्, i. e. वीज + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Having seed.
 2. Having sown seed, Man. 9, 51; 52.
 II. m. A father, a progenitor.

वीज्य वीज्य, i. e. वीज + य, adj.
 1. Sprung from seed.
 2. Sprung from some family.
 --Comp.
